articles.title: NASA’s Juno Measures Thickness of Europa’s Ice Shell

articles.summary: The NIRCam (Near-Infrared Camera) on NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope captured the actively forming protostar EC 53 (circled at left) in the Serpens Nebula in this image released on Jan. 21, 2026.
